Page 259 Cont.
Feb. 3rd. Miss. Mangan ... Saintly sufferer - found dead this a.m.
Mrs. Natilda Kalthoff - 73 - bleeding ulcers.
Frank Horton.
Page 260
Feb. 2 Francis Rauland - 53 - had six operations on cancers ... Thank God after six operations and 9 cancers removed is Okay.
Mrs. Latetia Stephens - Newardk, O. - Episcopelian - 81 - cancerous lip .... never sick till this started.
Feb. 4 Elmer Kapp - 18 - blind from amonia Explosion Dec. 9th last. Father was Catholic, Mother lutheran, Children baptized and seemingly little more - 17201 Goulburn
Rose Wyzykowski - 52 - High-blood Pres. Stroke a year ago ... Baby John Parport - 2 - peculiar condition - four weeks in Providence Rene Vereecke - 4% of Lyons, 0. - now in Ann Arbor Hosp. - threatening to be Spinal Maningitis - Mother non-Cath.
Eleanor Proszek - 17 - for quite a time deceiving mother and others now missing for some days.
Fr. Fr. Rajewski - 45 - 4 operations in fearful pains - gangreen feared.
Page 261 Feb. 5th Wm. Loney - 55 - high-bld - Deacon in Some Ch. in Episcopelian Ch. in Windsor - Catholic tenant asks for prayers ...
Ronald Howell - 8 month old - in Kiefer's. Very peculiar trouble. For six month was bright and normal; then high fever and something like paralysis .... Mother hesitating whether to take baby home or con- descend to having it consigned to institution.
6 Mrs. Enima Reno - 65 - fell early in December and since has had serious kidney trouble - and very little strength.
Sara Kane - 48 - fears operation.
